mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM tb_invite_signup s WHERE s.referrer_id = #{referrerId} AND s.result = 'LINKED'

SELECT u.name, s.created_at AS joined_at FROM tb_invite_signup s JOIN tb_user u ON u.user_id = s.user_id WHERE s.referrer_id = #{referrerId} AND s.result = 'LINKED' ORDER BY s.created_at DESC, s.invite_signup_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
